title: Atlas Edge Docs
tagline: Enterprise orchestration for autonomous field fleets.
description: Atlas Edge deployment guides and runbooks for robotics operations teams.

welcome.headline: Field Operations Launch Playbook
welcome.lead: Stand up your first Atlas-enabled site with resilient robotics control in under two weeks.
pillars: Guarantee resilient command even with intermittent connectivity.
Spin up telemetry pipelines and analytics dashboards in hours.
Keep every deployment compliant with prebuilt policy templates.
checklist: Install Atlas Relay at the facility edge.
Connect fleet controllers and register operator roles.
Validate telemetry feeds and schedule the go-live review.
welcome.quote: Atlas Edge keeps every field operation online and audit-ready, no matter the terrain.
